snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC CSE 2028 and wondering how to start Indian Economy? Which books should you follow, when should you start reading newspapers, and when should you begin solving MCQs and writing Mains answers?

In this video, Vivek Singh Sir, renowned UPSC Economy faculty and author of Indian Economy, shares a structured, beginner-friendly strategy for preparing Indian Economy for UPSC Prelims and Mains.

Book 1:1 Mentorship: https://shorturl.at/i3Mds

Apply For Rs.50,000 Scholarship for GS Foundation 2028: https://shorturl.at/ErilB

Explore GS Foundation 2028: https://shorturl.at/tHsHt

In this video, you'll learn:

- Why the UPSC syllabus and previous 10 years' PYQs should be your starting point.
- How to use Class 11 and 12 NCERTs and *Indian Economy by Vivek Singh*.
- When and how to read The Hindu or The Indian Express for Economy.
- Why you should build conceptual clarity before relying on newspaper-based preparation.
- When to start solving MCQs, practising PYQs, and writing Mains answers.
- How to approach the Union Budget and Economic Survey effectively.

The key advice: **Build your basics first. Understand the syllabus. Use PYQs to guide your preparation. Then gradually integrate current affairs, practice, and answer writing.**

If you are a beginner targeting **UPSC CSE 2028**, this session will help you approach Indian Economy with a clear and systematic preparation strategy.

#upsc2028  #indianeconomy  #upscpreparation  #upscbeginners  #VivekSinghSir #upscprelims  #upscmains  #economyforupsc  #levelupias
